# How can sparse-reward sports training avoid a policy that falls before it ever reaches useful reward?

> **Current answer:** The OP3 soccer work first trains the minimum get-up and soccer skills, then uses state-routed teacher regularization to distill them into one policy and a historical snapshot pool to learn combination and competition. This addresses exploration and forgetting; it does not mean end-to-end self-play creates basic skills automatically, and small OP3 hardware limits do not transfer to full-size humanoids.

## Key terms

- Motion Capture (MoCap, 动作捕捉)
- Self-Play (自博弈)

## Controllers and methods

- Teacher-regularized unified soccer policy
- Historical-pool self-play

## Applicable environments

- 1v1 biped soccer with repeatable skill and set-piece tests

## Assumptions

- Get-up and ball-skill teachers are independently competent and frozen for distillation.
- A historical opponent evaluation pool is preserved separately from training.

## Result

- The OP3 soccer work first trains the minimum get-up and soccer skills, then uses state-routed teacher regularization to distill them into one policy and a historical snapshot pool to learn combination and competition. This addresses exploration and forgetting; it does not mean end-to-end self-play creates basic skills automatically, and small OP3 hardware limits do not transfer to full-size humanoids.

## Limitations

- Get-up and ball-skill teachers are independently competent and frozen for distillation.
- A historical opponent evaluation pool is preserved separately from training.
